messages:
Morgan Lee: hey folks :wave: — day 2 and I still can't open the eng drive. Okta sign-in says 'No SSO apps available' and my credential-vault invite is still pending. who should I ping?

onboard-bot: welcome @Morgan Lee! Your onboarding pipeline shows account creation in progress. IT will be notified. If urgent, tag @IT Support.

Morgan Lee: tagged @IT Support — thanks. I tried both chrome and safari incognito. Okta shows 'Your org hasn't assigned apps to this account'. Screenshot in my DM.

IT Support: hey Morgan — can you confirm the exact corporate email you used to sign up? Also did you complete MFA enrollment (Okta Verify or phone)? I just pushed a re-assignment of the Google Workspace app; try again after 2–3 minutes. If you still see the error, try clearing cookies or opening via https://okta.redwood.ai/app/home.

Morgan Lee: it's morgan.lee@redwood.ai. I did the MFA flow but didn't get a push notification. Okta Verify shows the profile but no apps listed.

Alex Kim: fwiw we had similar last week — group membership sync from identity -> Google can lag ~20–40m after the app is assigned. IT usually fixes it by re-syncing the group. Samir can also drop you a temporary folder in the meantime.

IT Support: confirmed app assignment at 2146001242. Re-sent the credential-vault (1Password) invite — check spam. If the Okta push never arrives, open Okta Verify -> Manage devices -> 'Remove device' and re-enroll; that forces a fresh push. Admins can also trigger a manual group sync. If you want immediate access, Samir, can you add Morgan to a shared folder?

Samir Patel: added Morgan to eng-team-temp drive folder and uploaded a quickstart doc (onboarding/eng-setup.md). Also dropped a temp SSH key for day-1 tasks into the folder. Morgan, lmk if you need the repo invite too.

Morgan Lee: I can access the temp folder now — thanks everyone! 1Password invite still pending but I can follow the walkthrough. I'll try the device remove + re-enroll and update here. :thumbsup:
